story.title: Musk v. Altman Trial Ends With Jury to Decide Who Was Really Running OpenAI
story.summary: The final week of the Musk v. Altman trial saw both sides attack each other's credibility, with Altman accused of lying and self-dealing while he countered that Musk sought personal control over AI development. The jury must now decide whether Musk was misled into funding OpenAI under false pretences about its nonprofit mission. The verdict could reshape governance norms and legal accountability for the entire AI industry.
